verses.1:1: Now the Lord called Moses and spoke to him from the tabernacle of the testimony, saying,
verses.1:2: "Speak to the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them, 'A person from among you who offers a sacrifice to the Lord from the livestock, that is, offering victims from the cattle and the sheep,
verses.1:3: if his offering is a burnt offering, and from the herd, he shall offer an unblemished male at the doorway of the tabernacle of the testimony, to make the Lord favorable to himself.
verses.1:4: And he shall place his hand on the head of the sacrifice, and it will be acceptable and effective for his expiation.
verses.1:5: And he shall slaughter the calf before the Lord, and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall offer its blood, pouring it all around the altar that is before the doorway of the tabernacle.
verses.1:6: And when the skin of the sacrifice has been stripped off, they shall cut the limbs into pieces.
verses.1:7: And they shall place fire underneath on the altar, with a pile of wood arranged beforehand,
verses.1:8: also arranging on top the parts that have been cut, namely, the head and all that adheres to the liver,
verses.1:9: with the intestines and feet washed with water; and the priest shall burn them on the altar as a burnt offering and a sweet fragrance to the Lord.
verses.1:10: Now if the offering is from the livestock, a burnt offering from the sheep or from the goats, he shall offer a male without blemish,
verses.1:11: and he shall slaughter it at the side of the altar that faces toward the north, before the Lord; and the sons of Aaron shall pour its blood on the altar all around.
verses.1:12: And they shall divide the parts, the head, and all that adheres to the liver, and they shall place them on the wood under which fire is to be placed;
verses.1:13: but they shall wash the intestines and the feet with water. And the priest shall burn on the altar all that has been offered, as a burnt offering and a very sweet fragrance to the Lord.
verses.1:14: Now if the offering of a burnt offering to the Lord is from birds, from turtledoves or the young of a dove,
verses.1:15: the priest shall offer it at the altar, and with its head twisted back to the neck and the place of the wound broken open, he shall cause the blood to run down onto the ledge of the altar;
verses.1:16: but he shall throw the crop of the throat and the feathers near the altar toward the eastern side, in the place where the ashes are customarily poured out,
verses.1:17: and he shall break its wings, and shall not cut it nor divide it with iron, and he shall burn it on the altar, on the wood with fire placed underneath. It is a burnt offering and an offering of a very sweet fragrance to the Lord.'"
verses.2:1: "When a soul offers an offering of a sacrifice to the Lord, his offering shall be fine flour; and he shall pour oil over it and place frankincense on it,
verses.2:2: and he shall bring it to the sons of Aaron, the priests, one of whom shall take a full handful of the fine flour and of the oil, and all the frankincense, and shall place it as a memorial on the altar, as a very sweet fragrance to the Lord.
verses.2:3: Now what remains from the sacrifice shall belong to Aaron and his sons, most holy from the offerings of the Lord.
verses.2:4: Now when you offer a sacrifice baked in an oven, it shall be of fine flour, namely, loaves without leaven, mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers spread with oil.
verses.2:5: If your offering is from a frying pan, of fine flour mixed with oil and without leaven,
verses.2:6: you shall divide it into small pieces, and you shall pour oil over it.
verses.2:7: But if the sacrifice is from a grill, likewise the fine flour shall be mixed with oil;
verses.2:8: and offering it to the Lord, you shall deliver it into the hands of the priest.
verses.2:9: And when he has offered it, he shall take a memorial from the sacrifice and burn it on the altar as a fragrance of sweetness to the Lord;
verses.2:10: however, whatever remains shall belong to Aaron and his sons, most holy from the offerings of the Lord.
verses.2:11: Every offering that is offered to the Lord shall be made without leaven, nor shall anything of leaven or honey be burned in a sacrifice to the Lord.
verses.2:12: You shall offer only firstfruits of them and gifts; however, they shall not be placed on the altar as a fragrance of sweetness.
verses.2:13: Whatever sacrifice you offer, you shall season with salt, nor shall you remove the salt of the covenant of your God from your sacrifice; in every offering of yours you shall offer salt.
verses.2:14: Now if you offer a gift of your first produce to the Lord from ears of grain still green, you shall roast them with fire and crush them in the manner of coarse grain, and so you shall offer your firstfruits to the Lord,
verses.2:15: pouring oil on top and placing frankincense upon it, because it is an offering of the Lord,
verses.2:16: from which the priest shall burn as a memorial of the gift a part of the crushed grain and of the oil, and all the frankincense."
verses.3:1: "Now if his offering is a sacrifice of peace offerings, and he wishes to offer from the cattle, whether male or female, he shall offer it unblemished before the Lord.
verses.3:2: And he shall place his hand on the head of his victim, which shall be slaughtered at the entrance of the tabernacle of the testimony, and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall pour the blood all around the altar.
verses.3:3: And they shall offer from the sacrifice of peace offerings as an offering to the Lord the fat that covers the internal organs, and whatever fatness is inside:
verses.3:4: the two kidneys with the fat by which the flanks are covered, and the membrane of the liver with the kidneys.
verses.3:5: And they shall burn them on the altar as a burnt offering, on the wood with fire placed underneath, as an offering of a very sweet fragrance to the Lord.
verses.3:6: Now if his offering and sacrifice of peace offerings is from the sheep, whether he offers a male or a female, they shall be unblemished.
verses.3:7: If he offers a lamb before the Lord,
verses.3:8: he shall place his hand on the head of his victim, which shall be slaughtered in the vestibule of the tabernacle of the testimony; and the sons of Aaron shall pour its blood all around the altar.
verses.3:9: And they shall offer from the sacrifice of peace offerings a sacrifice to the Lord: the fat and the entire tail
verses.3:10: with the kidneys, and the fatness that covers the belly and all the internal organs, and both kidneys with the fat that is beside the flanks, and the membrane of the liver with the kidneys.
verses.3:11: And the priest shall burn them on the altar as food of the fire and of the offering of the Lord.
verses.3:12: If his offering is a goat, and he offers it to the Lord,
verses.3:13: he shall place his hand on its head, and he shall slaughter it at the entrance of the tabernacle of the testimony, and the sons of Aaron shall pour its blood all around the altar.
verses.3:14: And they shall take from it as sustenance for the Lord's fire the fat that covers the belly and that covers all the internal organs:
verses.3:15: the two kidneys with the membrane that is over them beside the flanks, and the fat of the liver with the kidneys;
verses.3:16: and the priest shall burn them on the altar as nourishment for the fire, and of a very sweet fragrance. All fat shall belong to the Lord
verses.3:17: by a perpetual statute throughout your generations and in all your dwellings; you shall not eat either blood or fat at all."
verses.4:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.4:2: "Speak to the sons of Israel: 'A soul who sins through ignorance and does anything of all the commandments of the Lord that He commanded should not be done:
verses.4:3: if the priest who is anointed sins, causing the people to offend, he shall offer for his sin an unblemished calf to the Lord:
verses.4:4: and he shall bring it to the doorway of the tabernacle of the testimony before the Lord, and he shall place his hand upon its head and sacrifice it to the Lord.
verses.4:5: He shall also draw from the blood of the calf, bringing it into the tabernacle of the testimony.
verses.4:6: And when he has dipped his finger in the blood, he shall sprinkle with it seven times before the Lord, facing the veil of the sanctuary.
verses.4:7: And he shall put some of that same blood upon the horns of the altar of incense most pleasing to the Lord, which is in the tabernacle of the testimony; but all the remaining blood he shall pour onto the base of the altar of burnt offering at the entrance of the tabernacle.
verses.4:8: And he shall remove the fat of the calf for sin, both that which covers the internal organs and all things that are inside:
verses.4:9: the two kidneys and the membrane that is over them beside the flanks, and the fat of the liver with the kidneys,
verses.4:10: just as it is removed from the calf of the sacrifice of peace offerings; and he shall burn them upon the altar of burnt offering.
verses.4:11: But the hide and all the flesh, with the head and the feet and the intestines and the dung,
verses.4:12: and the rest of the body, he shall carry outside the camp to a clean place, where the ashes are customarily poured out; and he shall set fire to them upon a pile of wood; they will be burned up in the place of the poured-out ashes.
verses.4:13: Now if the entire crowd of Israel is unaware, and through lack of knowledge does what is contrary to the commandment of the Lord,
verses.4:14: and afterward realizes its sin, it shall offer a calf for its sin, and bring it to the doorway of the tabernacle.
verses.4:15: And the elders of the people shall place their hands upon its head before the Lord. And when the calf has been sacrificed in the sight of the Lord,
verses.4:16: the priest who is anointed shall bring some of its blood into the tabernacle of the testimony,
verses.4:17: having dipped his finger, sprinkling seven times facing the veil.
verses.4:18: And he shall put some of that same blood on the horns of the altar that is before the Lord in the tabernacle of the testimony; but the remaining blood he shall pour beside the base of the altar of burnt offerings, which is at the doorway of the tabernacle of the testimony.
verses.4:19: And he shall take all its fat and burn it upon the altar,
verses.4:20: doing thus with this calf also just as he did before; and as the priest prays for them, the Lord will be merciful to them.
verses.4:21: But the calf itself he shall carry outside the camp and burn it completely, just like the first calf also, because it is for the sin of the multitude.
verses.4:22: If a prince sins, and through ignorance does one of many things that is forbidden by the law of the Lord,
verses.4:23: and afterward realizes his sin, he shall offer a sacrifice to the Lord, an unblemished male goat from the goats.
verses.4:24: And he shall place his hand upon its head; and when he has sacrificed it in the place where the burnt offering is customarily slaughtered before the Lord, because it is for sin,
verses.4:25: the priest shall dip his finger in the blood of the sacrifice for sin, touching the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and pouring the remainder at its base.
verses.4:26: But the fat he shall burn upon it, just as is customarily done with the victims of peace offerings; and the priest shall pray for him and for his sin, and it will be forgiven him.
verses.4:27: Now if a soul of the people of the land sins through ignorance, so as to do any of the things that are forbidden by the law of the Lord, and commits an offense,
verses.4:28: and comes to know his sin, he shall offer an unblemished female goat.
verses.4:29: And he shall place his hand upon the head of the sacrifice that is for sin, and sacrifice it in the place of burnt offering.
verses.4:30: And the priest shall take some of the blood on his finger; and touching the horns of the altar of burnt offering, he shall pour the remainder at its base.
verses.4:31: And removing all the fat, just as it is customarily removed from the victims of peace offerings, he shall burn it upon the altar for a fragrance of sweetness to the Lord; and he shall pray for him, and it will be forgiven him.
verses.4:32: But if instead he offers a victim for sin from the livestock, namely, an unblemished sheep:
verses.4:33: he shall place his hand upon its head, and sacrifice it in the place where the sacrifices of burnt offerings are customarily killed.
verses.4:34: And the priest shall take some of its blood with his finger, and touching the horns of the altar of burnt offering, he shall pour the remainder at its base.
verses.4:35: Also removing all the fat, just as the fat of the ram that is sacrificed for peace offerings is customarily removed, he shall burn it up upon the altar as a fire-offering of the Lord; and he shall pray for him and for his sin, and it will be forgiven him.'"
verses.5:1: "If a soul sins, and hears the voice of one swearing, and is a witness of what he either saw himself or is aware of: unless he discloses it, he will bear his iniquity.
verses.5:2: A soul who touches anything unclean, whether what was killed by a beast, or died on its own, or any other creeping thing, and forgets his uncleanness, is guilty and has offended;
verses.5:3: and if he touches anything of the uncleanness of a person, according to every impurity by which one is customarily defiled, and having forgotten, comes to know it afterward, he will be liable for the offense.
verses.5:4: A soul who swears and utters with his lips to do either something evil or something good, and confirms that very thing with an oath and speech, and having forgotten, afterward realizes his offense,
verses.5:5: let him repent for the sin,
verses.5:6: and let him offer from the flocks a female lamb or a female goat, and the priest shall pray for him and for his sin.
verses.5:7: But if instead he is not able to offer a head of livestock, let him offer two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the Lord, one for sin and the other for a burnt offering,
verses.5:8: and he shall give them to the priest, who, offering the first one for sin, shall twist back its head toward the little wings, so that it clings to the neck and is not completely broken off.
verses.5:9: And he shall sprinkle the wall of the altar with some of its blood; but whatever remains, he shall cause to drip down at its foundation, because it is for sin.
verses.5:10: But the other he shall burn for a burnt offering, as is customarily done; and the priest shall pray for him and for his sin, and it will be forgiven him.
verses.5:11: Now if his hand is not able to offer two turtledoves or two young pigeons, he shall offer for his sin a tenth part of an ephah of fine flour; he shall not put oil into it, nor place any frankincense upon it, because it is for sin.
verses.5:12: And he shall hand it over to the priest, who, drawing a full handful from it, shall burn it up upon the altar as a memorial of the one who offered it,
verses.5:13: praying for him and making expiation; but the remaining part he himself shall have as a gift."
verses.5:14: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.5:15: "If a soul, violating the ceremonies through error, sins in the things that have been sanctified to the Lord, he shall offer for his offense an unblemished ram from the flocks, which can be bought for two shekels, according to the weight of the sanctuary;
verses.5:16: and he shall restore the very loss that he caused, and place a fifth part on top of it, handing it over to the priest, who shall pray for him while offering the ram, and it will be forgiven him.
verses.5:17: If a soul sins through ignorance, and does one of the things that are forbidden by the law of the Lord, and, guilty of sin, realizes his iniquity,
verses.5:18: he shall offer an unblemished ram from the flocks to the priest, according to the measure and valuation of the sin, who shall pray for him because he did it unknowingly, and it will be forgiven him,
verses.5:19: because through error he offended against the Lord."
verses.5:20: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.5:21: "A soul who sins and, having despised the Lord, denies to his neighbor a deposit that had been committed to his trust, or extorts something by force, or makes a false accusation,
verses.5:22: or finds a lost item and, denying it, moreover swears falsely, and does any other of the many things in which people customarily sin,
verses.5:24: he shall return in full everything that he wanted to obtain through fraud, and a fifth part in addition to the owner to whom he had caused the loss.
verses.5:25: But for his sin he shall offer an unblemished ram from the flock, and give it to the priest, according to the valuation and measure of the offense;
verses.5:26: who shall pray for him before the Lord, and it will be forgiven him for each of the things that he sinned by doing."
verses.6:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.6:2: "Command Aaron and his sons, 'This is the law of the burnt offering: it will be burned on the altar all night until morning; the fire will be from the same altar.
verses.6:3: The priest will clothe himself in a tunic and linen undergarments, and he will take up the ashes that the devouring fire has burned, and setting them beside the altar,
verses.6:4: he will take off the former garments, and clothed in others, he will carry them outside the camp, and in a very clean place he will cause them to be consumed down to fine ash.
verses.6:5: Now the fire on the altar will always burn, which the priest will feed, placing wood underneath in the morning each day; and with the burnt offering placed upon it, he will burn the fats of the peace offerings on top.
verses.6:6: This is the perpetual fire, which will never fail on the altar.
verses.6:7: This is the law of the sacrifice and of the libations, which the sons of Aaron will offer before the Lord and before the altar.
verses.6:8: The priest will take a handful of the fine flour that has been moistened with oil, and all the frankincense that has been placed on the fine flour, and he will burn it on the altar as a memorial of a very sweet fragrance to the Lord;
verses.6:9: but Aaron will eat the remaining part of the fine flour with his sons, without leaven, and he will eat it in the holy place of the courtyard of the tabernacle.
verses.6:10: Now it will not be leavened for this reason, because part of it is offered as a fire offering of the Lord. It will be most holy, just like that for sin and for trespass.
verses.6:11: Only the males of the lineage of Aaron will eat it. It will be a lawful and everlasting ordinance in your generations from the sacrifices of the Lord: everyone who touches them will be made holy.'"
verses.6:12: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.6:13: "This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they ought to offer to the Lord on the day of their anointing. They will offer a tenth part of an ephah of fine flour as an everlasting sacrifice, half of it in the morning, and half of it in the evening,
verses.6:14: which, moistened with oil, will be fried in a frying pan. And it will be offered hot for a very sweet fragrance to the Lord
verses.6:15: by the priest who succeeds his father by right, and all of it will be burned on the altar.
verses.6:16: For every sacrifice of the priests will be consumed by fire, and no one will eat from it."
verses.6:17: Now the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.6:18: "Speak to Aaron and his sons, 'This is the law of the sacrifice for sin: in the place where the burnt offering is offered, it will be sacrificed before the Lord. It is most holy.
verses.6:19: The priest who offers it will eat it in a holy place, in the courtyard of the tabernacle.
verses.6:20: Whatever touches its flesh will be made holy. If a garment is sprinkled with some of its blood, it will be washed in a holy place.
verses.6:21: Now a clay vessel in which it was cooked will be broken; but if it is a bronze vessel, it will be scoured and washed with water.
verses.6:22: Every male of the priestly family will eat from its flesh, because it is most holy.
verses.6:23: For a sacrifice that is killed for sin, whose blood is brought into the tabernacle of the testimony to make expiation in the sanctuary, will not be eaten, but will be burned up with fire.'"
verses.7:1: This also is the law of the sacrifice for trespass; it is most holy.
verses.7:2: Therefore, where the burnt offering will be sacrificed, the victim for trespass will also be slaughtered; its blood will be poured out all around the altar.
verses.7:3: They will offer from it the tail and the fat that covers the internal organs,
verses.7:4: the two kidneys, and the fat that is beside the flanks, and the membrane of the liver with the kidneys.
verses.7:5: And the priest will burn them on the altar; it is a fire offering of the Lord for trespass.
verses.7:6: Every male of the priestly family will eat this flesh in a holy place, because it is most holy.
verses.7:7: Just as the sacrifice is offered for sin, so also for trespass: there will be one law for both sacrifices; it will belong to the priest who offers it.
verses.7:8: The priest who offers the victim of a burnt offering will have its hide.
verses.7:9: And every sacrifice of fine flour that is baked in an oven, and whatever is prepared on a gridiron or in a frying pan, will belong to the priest by whom it is offered;
verses.7:10: whether moistened with oil or dry, it will be divided among all the sons of Aaron in equal measure for each one.
verses.7:11: This is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings that is offered to the Lord.
verses.7:12: If the offering is for thanksgiving, they will offer loaves without leaven moistened with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cooked fine flour, and cakes moistened with a mixture of oil,
verses.7:13: also leavened loaves with the sacrifice of thanksgiving, which is sacrificed for peace offerings,
verses.7:14: from which one will be offered as firstfruits to the Lord, and it will belong to the priest who will pour out the blood of the sacrifice,
verses.7:15: whose flesh will be eaten on the same day, and nothing from it will remain until morning.
verses.7:16: If anyone offers a sacrifice by a vow or voluntarily, it will likewise be eaten on the same day; yet even if anything remains until the next day, it is lawful to eat it;
verses.7:17: but whatever the third day finds, fire will consume.
verses.7:18: If anyone eats from the flesh of the victim of peace offerings on the third day, the offering will become void, nor will it benefit the one offering it; on the contrary, whatever soul defiles itself with such food will be guilty of transgression.
verses.7:19: Flesh that touches anything unclean will not be eaten, but will be burned up with fire; the one who is clean will eat from it.
verses.7:20: A polluted soul that eats from the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings that has been offered to the Lord will perish from its peoples.
verses.7:21: And the soul that touches the uncleanness of a person, or of a beast, or of any thing that can pollute, and eats from flesh of this kind, will perish from its peoples.
verses.7:22: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.7:23: "Speak to the sons of Israel, 'You will not eat the fat of a sheep, or of an ox, or of a goat.
verses.7:24: The fat of a carcass that died of itself, and of an animal that was caught by a wild beast, you will have for various uses.
verses.7:25: If anyone eats the fat that ought to be offered as a fire offering of the Lord, he will perish from his people.
verses.7:26: Also, you will not take the blood of any animal as food, whether of birds or of livestock.
verses.7:27: Every soul that eats blood will perish from its peoples.'"
verses.7:28: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.7:29: "Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, 'Let the one who offers a victim of peace offerings to the Lord offer at the same time also the sacrifice, that is, its libations.
verses.7:30: He will hold in his hands the fat of the sacrifice and the breast; and when he has offered and consecrated both to the Lord, he will hand them over to the priest,
verses.7:31: who will burn the fat on the altar, but the breast will belong to Aaron and his sons.
verses.7:32: The right shoulder also from the sacrifices of peace offerings will go as the firstfruits of the priest.
verses.7:33: The one among the sons of Aaron who offers the blood and the fat, he himself will also have the right shoulder as his portion.
verses.7:34: For I have taken the breast of elevation and the shoulder of separation from the sons of Israel, from their peace sacrifices, and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons by a perpetual law, from all the people of Israel.'"
verses.7:35: This is the anointing of Aaron and of his sons in the ceremonies of the Lord on the day on which Moses presented them so that they might serve in the priesthood,
verses.7:36: and the things that the Lord commanded to be given to them by the sons of Israel by a perpetual observance in their generations.
verses.7:37: This is the law of the burnt offering, and of the sacrifice for sin and trespass, and for consecration, and of the victims of peace offerings,
verses.7:38: which the Lord established for Moses on Mount Sinai, when He commanded the sons of Israel to offer their offerings to the Lord in the desert of Sinai.
verses.8:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.8:2: "Take Aaron with his sons, their garments and the anointing oil, a calf for sin, two rams, and a basket with unleavened bread;
verses.8:3: and you shall gather the whole assembly at the entrance of the tabernacle."
verses.8:4: Moses did as the Lord had commanded. And when the whole crowd had been gathered before the doors of the tabernacle,
verses.8:5: he said, "This is the word that the Lord has ordered to be done."
verses.8:6: And immediately he brought forward Aaron and his sons. And when he had washed them,
verses.8:7: he clothed the high priest in the linen under-tunic, fastening the sash around him and dressing him in the violet-blue tunic, and over it he placed the shoulder-vestment,
verses.8:8: which he bound tightly with the waistband and fitted to the breastpiece, in which was Doctrine and Truth.
verses.8:9: He also covered his head with the turban, and upon it, in front of his forehead, he placed the golden plate consecrated in sanctification, just as the Lord had commanded him.
verses.8:10: He also took the anointing oil, with which he anointed the tabernacle with all its furnishings.
verses.8:11: And when, sanctifying it, he had sprinkled the altar seven times, he anointed it and all its vessels, and the basin along with its base he sanctified with oil.
verses.8:12: Pouring this on Aaron's head, he anointed him and consecrated him.
verses.8:13: Having brought forward his sons as well, he clothed them in linen tunics, fastened sashes around them, and placed headdresses on them, as the Lord had ordered.
verses.8:14: He also brought forward the calf for sin; and when Aaron and his sons had placed their hands on its head,
verses.8:15: he sacrificed it, drawing the blood, and dipping his finger, he touched the horns of the altar all around; and when it had been purified and sanctified, he poured out the remaining blood at its foundations.
verses.8:16: But the fat that was on the internal organs, and the membrane of the liver, and the two kidneys with their suet, he burned on the altar,
verses.8:17: burning up the calf with its hide, and flesh, and dung outside the camp, just as the Lord had commanded.
verses.8:18: He also brought forward the ram for a burnt offering; and when Aaron and his sons had laid their hands on its head,
verses.8:19: he sacrificed it and poured out its blood all around the altar.
verses.8:20: And cutting the ram itself into pieces, he burned its head, its limbs, and its fat with fire,
verses.8:21: after first washing the intestines and the feet; and he burned the entire ram together on the altar, because it was a burnt offering of a most sweet fragrance to the Lord, just as He had commanded him.
verses.8:22: He also brought forward the second ram for the consecration of the priests, and Aaron and his sons placed their hands on its head.
verses.8:23: When Moses had sacrificed it, taking some of its blood, he touched the tip of Aaron's right ear, and the thumb of his right hand, and likewise the big toe of his foot.
verses.8:24: He also brought forward the sons of Aaron; and when with some of the blood of the sacrificed ram he had touched the tip of each one's right ear, and the thumbs of their right hands and the big toes of their right feet, he poured out the rest on the altar all around.
verses.8:25: But he separated the fat, and the tail, and all the fatness that covers the intestines, and the membrane of the liver, and the two kidneys with their fat and the right shoulder.
verses.8:26: And taking from the basket of unleavened bread that was before the Lord a loaf without leaven, and a cake mixed with oil, and a wafer, he placed them on the fat pieces and the right shoulder,
verses.8:27: delivering them all together to Aaron and his sons. And after they had lifted them up before the Lord,
verses.8:28: taking them back again from their hands, he burned them on the altar of burnt offering, because it was an offering of consecration, for a fragrance of sweetness, of a sacrifice to the Lord.
verses.8:29: And he took the breast, lifting it up before the Lord, from the ram of consecration as his portion, just as the Lord had commanded him.
verses.8:30: And taking the ointment and the blood that was on the altar, he sprinkled them on Aaron and his vestments, and on his sons and their garments.
verses.8:31: And when he had sanctified them in their attire, he commanded them, saying, "Cook the flesh before the doors of the tabernacle, and eat it there; eat also the loaves of consecration that have been placed in the basket, just as the Lord commanded me, saying, 'Aaron and his sons shall eat them.'
verses.8:32: But whatever remains of the flesh and the loaves, fire will consume.
verses.8:33: Also, you shall not go out from the entrance of the tabernacle for seven days, until the day on which the time of your consecration will be completed; for in seven days the consecration is finished,
verses.8:34: just as has also been done at the present time, so that the rite of the sacrifice might be completed.
verses.8:35: Day and night you shall remain in the tabernacle, keeping the watches of the Lord, so that you do not die; for so I have been commanded."
verses.8:36: And Aaron and his sons did everything that the Lord had spoken through the hand of Moses.
verses.9:1: Now when the eighth day had come, Moses called Aaron, and his sons, and the elders of Israel, and said to Aaron,
verses.9:2: "Take from the herd a calf for sin, and a ram for a burnt offering, both unblemished, and offer them before the Lord.
verses.9:3: And to the sons of Israel you shall speak, 'Take a male goat for sin, and a calf and a lamb, a year old and without blemish, for a burnt offering,
verses.9:4: an ox and a ram for peace offerings; and sacrifice them before the Lord, offering fine flour mixed with oil in the sacrifice of each one; for today the Lord will appear to you.'"
verses.9:5: Therefore they brought all the things that Moses had ordered to the entrance of the tabernacle, where, while the whole multitude stood by,
verses.9:6: Moses said, "This is the word that the Lord has commanded: do it, and His glory will appear to you."
verses.9:7: And he said to Aaron, "Approach the altar and sacrifice for your sin; offer the burnt offering, and intercede for yourself and for the people; and when you have slaughtered the sacrifice of the people, pray for them, just as the Lord has commanded."
verses.9:8: And immediately Aaron, approaching the altar, sacrificed the calf for his sin,
verses.9:9: whose blood his sons brought to him; dipping his finger in it, he touched the horns of the altar and poured out the remainder at its base.
verses.9:10: And the fat, and the kidneys, and the membrane of the liver, which are for sin, he burned on the altar, just as the Lord had commanded Moses;
verses.9:11: but its flesh and its hide he burned up with fire outside the camp.
verses.9:12: He also sacrificed the victim of the burnt offering; and his sons brought its blood to him, which he poured out all around the altar.
verses.9:13: They also brought the sacrifice itself, cut into pieces, with the head and each of the limbs, all of which he burned with fire on the altar,
verses.9:14: after first washing the intestines and the feet with water.
verses.9:15: And offering for the sin of the people, he slaughtered the male goat; and when the altar had been purified,
verses.9:17: adding in the sacrifice the libations that are offered along with it, and burning them on the altar, apart from the ceremonies of the morning burnt offering.
verses.9:18: He also sacrificed the ox and the ram, the peace sacrifices of the people; and his sons brought the blood to him, which he poured out on the altar all around.
verses.9:19: And the fat of the ox, and the tail of the ram, and the kidneys with their fat, and the membrane of the liver,
verses.9:20: they placed on the breasts; and when the fat pieces had been burned on the altar,
verses.9:21: Aaron separated their breasts and right shoulders, lifting them up before the Lord, just as Moses had commanded.
verses.9:22: And stretching out his hands toward the people, he blessed them. And thus, when the sacrifices for sin, and the burnt offerings, and the peace offerings had been completed, he came down.
verses.9:23: And Moses and Aaron entered the tabernacle of the testimony, and afterward came out and blessed the people. And the glory of the Lord appeared to the whole multitude;
verses.9:24: and look, fire came out from the Lord and devoured the burnt offering and the fat pieces that were on the altar. And when the crowds saw this, they praised the Lord, falling on their faces.
verses.10:1: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, seizing censers, placed fire in them and incense on top, offering foreign fire before the Lord, which had not been commanded to them.
verses.10:2: And fire went out from the Lord and devoured them, and they died before the Lord.
verses.10:3: And Moses said to Aaron, "This is what the Lord spoke: 'I will be sanctified in those who draw near to Me, and in the sight of all the people I will be glorified.'" Hearing this, Aaron kept silent.
verses.10:4: Now Moses, having summoned Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel, Aaron's uncle, said to them, "Go and take up your brothers from the sight of the sanctuary, and carry them outside the camp."
verses.10:5: And going immediately, they took them up just as they lay, clothed in linen tunics, and cast them outside, as had been commanded to them.
verses.10:6: And Moses spoke to Aaron, and to Eleazar and Ithamar, his sons, "Do not uncover your heads, and do not tear your garments, so that you might not die and indignation arise over the entire assembly. Let your brothers, and the entire house of Israel, mourn the burning that the Lord has kindled;
verses.10:7: but you shall not go out the doors of the tabernacle, otherwise you will perish; for the oil of holy anointing is upon you." And they did all things according to the command of Moses.
verses.10:8: The Lord also said to Aaron,
verses.10:9: "Wine, and anything that can intoxicate, you and your sons shall not drink when you enter the tabernacle of the testimony, so that you may not die; for it is an everlasting command throughout your generations,
verses.10:10: and so that you may have the knowledge to distinguish between the holy and the profane, between the defiled and the clean,
verses.10:11: and may teach the sons of Israel all My statutes that the Lord has spoken to them by the hand of Moses."
verses.10:12: And Moses spoke to Aaron, and to Eleazar and Ithamar, his sons who were left, "Take the sacrifice that remained from the offering of the Lord, and eat it without leaven beside the altar, for it is most holy.
verses.10:13: And you shall eat in a holy place what has been given to you and to your sons from the offerings of the Lord, as was commanded to me.
verses.10:14: Also, the breast that was offered and the shoulder that was set apart, you shall eat in a most clean place, you and your sons, and your daughters with you; for they have been reserved for you and your children from the sacrifices of salvation of the sons of Israel,
verses.10:15: because they have lifted up the shoulder and the breast, and the fat portions that are burned on the altar, before the Lord, and they belong to you and to your sons by a perpetual law, just as the Lord has commanded."
verses.10:16: Meanwhile, when Moses searched for the male goat that had been offered for sin, he found it burned up; and being angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron who had remained, he said,
verses.10:17: "Why did you not eat the sacrifice for sin in a holy place, which is most holy, and was given to you so that you might bear the iniquity of the multitude and pray for it in the sight of the Lord,
verses.10:18: especially since none of its blood was brought inside the holy places, and you ought to have eaten it in the sanctuary, as was commanded to me?"
verses.10:19: Aaron answered, "Today the victim for sin and the burnt offering have been offered before the Lord, yet what you see has happened to me; how could I eat it, or please the Lord in the ceremonies with a mournful mind?"
verses.10:20: When Moses had heard this, he accepted satisfaction.
verses.11:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.11:2: "Speak to the sons of Israel: 'These are the animals that you are to eat from all the living creatures of the earth:
verses.11:3: everything that has a divided hoof and chews the cud among the beasts, you shall eat.
verses.11:4: However, whatever chews the cud and has a hoof, yet does not divide it, such as the camel and the rest, you shall not eat it, and you shall count it among the unclean.
verses.11:5: The rock badger, which chews the cud and does not divide the hoof, is unclean.
verses.11:6: The hare also, for it too chews the cud, but does not divide the hoof.
verses.11:7: And the pig, which, although it divides the hoof, does not chew the cud.
verses.11:8: You shall not eat their flesh, nor shall you touch their carcasses, for they are unclean to you.
verses.11:9: These are the things that are bred in the waters and that are lawful to eat: everything that has fins and scales, both in the sea and in rivers and ponds, you shall eat.
verses.11:10: However, whatever does not have fins and scales, among those things that move and live in the waters, will be abominable to you
verses.11:11: and detestable: you shall not eat their flesh, and you shall avoid their dead bodies.
verses.11:12: All things that do not have fins and scales in the waters will be defiled.
verses.11:13: These are the ones among the birds that you are not to eat, and that are to be avoided by you: the eagle, and the griffin, and the sea eagle,
verses.11:14: and the kite and the vulture according to its kind,
verses.11:15: and everything of the raven kind in its likeness,
verses.11:16: the ostrich, and the night owl, and the gull, and the hawk according to its kind;
verses.11:17: the eagle owl, and the cormorant, and the ibis,
verses.11:18: and the swan, and the pelican, and the purple gallinule,
verses.11:19: the heron, and the plover according to its kind, the hoopoe also, and the bat.
verses.11:20: Everything among winged creatures that walks on four feet will be abominable to you.
verses.11:21: However, whatever walks on four feet, yet has longer hind legs with which it leaps upon the earth,
verses.11:22: you are to eat, such as the wingless locust in its kind, and the attacus, and the ophiomachus, and the locust, each according to its kind.
verses.11:23: However, whatever among winged creatures has only four feet will be detestable to you;
verses.11:24: and whoever touches their dead bodies will be defiled, and will be unclean until evening;
verses.11:25: and if it is necessary for him to carry any of these when dead, he shall wash his garments, and he will be unclean until sunset.
verses.11:26: Every animal that has a hoof, yet does not divide it, nor chews the cud, will be unclean; and whoever touches it will be contaminated.
verses.11:27: Whatever walks on paws, out of all the living creatures that go on all fours, will be unclean; whoever touches their dead bodies will be defiled until evening.
verses.11:28: And whoever carries carcasses of this kind shall wash his garments, and he will be unclean until evening; for all these are unclean to you.
verses.11:29: These also shall be counted among the defiled, of the things that move on the earth: the weasel, and the mouse, and the crocodile, each according to its kind,
verses.11:30: the shrew, and the chameleon, and the spotted lizard, and the lizard, and the mole.
verses.11:31: All these are unclean. Whoever touches their dead bodies will be unclean until evening;
verses.11:32: and anything upon which something from their dead bodies falls will be defiled, both a wooden vessel and a garment, as well as skins and haircloths, and anything with which work is done; they shall be dipped in water, and will be defiled until evening, and thus afterward they will be made clean.
verses.11:33: However, a clay vessel into which any of these has fallen inside will be defiled, and therefore it must be broken.
verses.11:34: All food that you eat, if water has been poured upon it, will be unclean; and every liquid that is drunk from any vessel will be unclean.
verses.11:35: And everything upon which anything from dead bodies of this kind falls will be unclean: whether ovens or footed pots, they shall be destroyed, and will be unclean.
verses.11:36: However, springs and cisterns, and every gathering of waters, will be clean. Whoever touches a dead body of theirs will be defiled.
verses.11:37: If it falls upon sowing seed, it will not defile it.
verses.11:38: But if anyone pours water over the sowing seed, and afterward it is touched by dead bodies, it will immediately be defiled.
verses.11:39: If an animal dies that is lawful for you to eat, whoever touches its carcass will be unclean until evening;
verses.11:40: and whoever eats anything from it, or carries it, shall wash his garments, and he will be unclean until evening.
verses.11:41: Everything that creeps upon the earth will be abominable, and shall not be taken for food.
verses.11:42: Whatever walks on its breast on four feet, and has many feet, or drags itself along the ground, you shall not eat, for it is abominable.
verses.11:43: Do not contaminate your souls, nor touch any of them, so that you may not be unclean.
verses.11:44: For I am the Lord your God: be holy, for I am holy. Do not defile your souls with any creeping creature that moves upon the earth.
verses.11:45: For I am the Lord, who brought you out of the land of Egypt so that I might be God to you. You shall be holy, for I am holy.
verses.11:46: This is the law of living creatures and winged creatures, and of every living soul that moves in the water and creeps on the earth,
verses.11:47: so that you may know the differences between the clean and the unclean, and may know what you are to eat and what to reject.'"
verses.12:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.12:2: "Speak to the sons of Israel, and you will say to them: 'If a woman, after receiving seed, gives birth to a male, she shall be unclean for seven days, according to the days of menstrual separation.
verses.12:3: And on the eighth day the little infant shall be circumcised;
verses.12:4: she herself, however, shall remain for thirty-three days in the blood of her purification. She shall not touch anything holy, nor shall she enter into the sanctuary, until the days of her purification are fulfilled.
verses.12:5: If, however, she gives birth to a female, she shall be unclean for two weeks, according to the custom of menstrual flow, and she shall remain for sixty-six days in the blood of her purification.
verses.12:6: And when the days of her purification have been completed, for a son or for a daughter, she shall bring a one-year-old lamb for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon or a turtledove for sin, to the entrance of the tabernacle of the testimony, and hand them over to the priest,
verses.12:7: who shall offer them before the Lord and pray for her, and thus she will be cleansed from the discharge of her blood. This is the law for one who gives birth to a male or a female.
verses.12:8: But if her hand does not find enough, and she is not able to offer a lamb, she shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons, one for a burnt offering and the other for sin; and the priest shall pray for her, and thus she will be cleansed.'"
verses.13:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.13:2: "A person in whose skin and flesh a different color arises, or a pustule, or something as though shining, that is, a plague of leprosy, will be brought to Aaron the priest, or to any one of his sons.
verses.13:3: And when he sees leprosy in the skin, and the hairs changed to a white color, and the appearance of the leprosy itself lower than the skin and the rest of the flesh, it is a plague of leprosy, and at his decision he will be separated.
verses.13:4: But if there is a shining whiteness in the skin, and it is not lower than the rest of the flesh, and the hairs are of their former color, the priest will confine him for seven days,
verses.13:5: and will examine him on the seventh day; and if indeed the leprosy has grown no further, nor crossed its former limits in the skin, he will confine him again for another seven days.
verses.13:6: And on the seventh day he will inspect him: if the leprosy is dimmer and has not grown in the skin, he will pronounce him clean, because it is a scab; and the person will wash his garments and will be clean.
verses.13:7: But if, after he has been seen by the priest and restored to cleanness, the leprosy has grown again, he will be brought to him,
verses.13:8: and will be condemned to uncleanness.
verses.13:9: If a plague of leprosy is in a person, he will be brought to the priest,
verses.13:10: and he will see him. And when there is a white color in the skin, and it has changed the appearance of the hairs, and the living flesh itself has also appeared,
verses.13:11: it will be judged a very old leprosy, and ingrained in the skin. Therefore the priest will pronounce him unclean, and will not confine him, because his uncleanness is evident.
verses.13:12: But if the leprosy breaks out, spreading in the skin, and covers all the skin from the head all the way to the feet, whatever falls under the sight of the eyes,
verses.13:13: the priest will examine him, and will judge him to be held by a most clean leprosy, because all of it has turned to whiteness, and therefore the person will be clean.
verses.13:14: But when living flesh appears in him,
verses.13:15: then by the judgment of the priest he will be pronounced defiled, and will be counted among the unclean; for living flesh, if it is sprinkled with leprosy, is unclean.
verses.13:16: But if it has turned again to whiteness and has covered the whole person,
verses.13:17: the priest will examine him, and will decree him to be clean.
verses.13:18: Now as for flesh and skin in which an ulcer has formed and been healed,
verses.13:19: and in the place of the ulcer a white or reddish scar has appeared, the person will be brought to the priest.
verses.13:20: And when he sees the place of the leprosy lower than the rest of the flesh, and the hairs turned to whiteness, he will pronounce him unclean; for the plague of leprosy has arisen in the ulcer.
verses.13:21: But if the hair is of its former color, and the scar is somewhat dim, and it is not lower than the neighboring flesh, he will confine him for seven days;
verses.13:22: and if indeed it has grown, he will adjudge him to leprosy;
verses.13:23: but if it has remained in its place, it is the scar of the ulcer, and the person will be clean.
verses.13:24: Now as for flesh and skin that fire has burned, and that when healed has a white or red scar,
verses.13:25: the priest will examine it, and look, it has turned to whiteness, and its place is lower than the rest of the skin; he will pronounce him unclean, because the plague of leprosy has arisen in the scar.
verses.13:26: But if the color of the hairs has not been changed, nor is the plague lower than the rest of the flesh, and the appearance of the leprosy itself is somewhat dim, he will confine him for seven days,
verses.13:27: and on the seventh day he will inspect him: if the leprosy has grown in the skin, he will pronounce him unclean.
verses.13:28: But if the whiteness has remained in its place, not very bright, it is a wound of burning, and therefore he will be pronounced clean, because it is the scar of a burn.
verses.13:29: As for a man or a woman on whose head or beard leprosy has sprouted, the priest will see them.
verses.13:30: And if indeed the place is lower than the rest of the flesh, and the hair is yellow and thinner than usual, he will pronounce them unclean, because it is leprosy of the head and beard.
verses.13:31: But if he sees the place of the spot level with the neighboring flesh, and the hair black, he will confine him for seven days,
verses.13:32: and on the seventh day he will observe him. If the spot has not grown, and the hair is of its own color, and the place of the plague is level with the rest of the flesh,
verses.13:33: the person will be shaved, except for the place of the spot, and will be shut in for another seven days.
verses.13:34: If on the seventh day the plague is seen to have remained in its place, and is not lower than the rest of the flesh, he will pronounce him clean; and once his clothes have been washed, he will be clean.
verses.13:35: But if after cleansing the spot has grown again in the skin,
verses.13:36: he will inquire no further whether the hair has been changed to a yellow color, because he is plainly unclean.
verses.13:37: Moreover, if the spot has stood still and the hairs are black, let him recognize that the person has been healed, and let him declare him clean with confidence.
verses.13:38: As for a man or a woman in whose skin whiteness has appeared,
verses.13:39: the priest will observe them. If he detects a somewhat dim whiteness shining in the skin, let him know that it is not leprosy, but a spot of white color, and that the person is clean.
verses.13:40: A man from whose head the hairs fall out is bald and clean;
verses.13:41: and if the hairs have fallen from the forehead, he is bald at the forehead and clean.
verses.13:42: But if in the baldness or in the forehead baldness a white or red color has arisen,
verses.13:43: and the priest sees this, he will condemn him to unquestionable leprosy, which has arisen in the baldness.
verses.13:44: Whoever therefore has been stained with leprosy, and has been separated at the decision of the priest,
verses.13:45: will have unstitched garments, a bare head, his mouth covered with a garment, and will cry out that he is defiled and filthy.
verses.13:46: For all the time during which he is leprous and unclean, he will live alone outside the camp.
verses.13:47: A woolen or linen garment that has leprosy,
verses.13:48: in the warp and the weft, or indeed leather, or anything made of leather,
verses.13:49: if it has been tainted with a white or red spot, it will be counted as leprosy, and will be shown to the priest,
verses.13:50: who, having examined it, will confine it for seven days;
verses.13:51: and looking at it again on the seventh day, if he detects that it has grown, it is a persistent leprosy; he will judge the garment defiled, and everything in which it has been found,
verses.13:52: and therefore it will be burned up in flames.
verses.13:53: But if he sees that it has not grown,
verses.13:54: he will command, and they will wash that in which the leprosy is, and he will confine it for another seven days.
verses.13:55: And when he sees that the former appearance indeed has not returned, and yet that the leprosy has not grown, he will judge it unclean and will burn it up with fire, because the leprosy has been infused into the surface of the garment, or throughout the whole.
verses.13:56: But if the place of the leprosy is dimmer after the garment has been washed, he will tear it off and will separate it from the sound part.
verses.13:57: But if it appears further in those places that were previously unspotted, a flying and wandering leprosy, it must be burned up with fire.
verses.13:58: If it has ceased, he will wash the things that are pure with water a second time, and they will be clean.
verses.13:59: This is the law of the leprosy of a woolen and linen garment, of the warp and the weft, and of every leather article, how it ought to be pronounced clean or pronounced unclean."
verses.14:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.14:2: "This is the rite of a leper when he is to be cleansed. He will be brought to the priest,
verses.14:3: who, having gone out from the camp, when he finds that the leprosy has been cleansed,
verses.14:4: will command the one who is being purified to offer for himself two living sparrows that it is lawful to eat, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop.
verses.14:5: And he will order one of the sparrows to be sacrificed in a clay vessel over living waters;
verses.14:6: but he will dip the other living one, with the cedar wood, the scarlet, and the hyssop, in the blood of the sacrificed sparrow,
verses.14:7: with which he will sprinkle the one who is to be cleansed seven times, so that he may be lawfully purged; and he will release the living sparrow so that it may fly away into the field.
verses.14:8: And when the man has washed his garments, he will shave all the hair of his body and will wash himself with water; and having been purified, he will enter the camp, provided only that he remains outside his tent for seven days,
verses.14:9: and on the seventh day he will shave the hair of his head, and his beard and eyebrows, and the hair of his whole body. And when his garments and body have been washed again,
verses.14:10: on the eighth day he will take two unblemished lambs, and a year-old ewe without blemish, and three tenths of fine flour, which is mixed with oil, for a sacrifice, and separately a sextarius of oil.
verses.14:11: And when the priest purifying the man has set him and all these things before the Lord at the doorway of the tabernacle of the testimony,
verses.14:12: he will take a lamb and offer it for trespass, and the sextarius of oil; and when all of them have been offered before the Lord,
verses.14:13: he will sacrifice the lamb where the victim for sin and the burnt offering are accustomed to be sacrificed, that is, in the holy place. For just as for sin, so also for trespass the victim belongs to the priest; it is most holy.
verses.14:14: And the priest, taking some of the blood of the victim that was sacrificed for trespass, will put it on the tip of the right ear of the one who is being cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand and the big toe of his right foot;
verses.14:15: and from the sextarius of oil he will pour some into his left hand,
verses.14:16: and he will dip his right finger in it and sprinkle before the Lord seven times.
verses.14:17: And what remains of the oil in his left hand he will pour on the tip of the right ear of the one who is being cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand and the big toe of his right foot, and on the blood that was poured out for trespass,
verses.14:19: And he will pray for him before the Lord and will make the sacrifice for sin; then he will sacrifice the burnt offering,
verses.14:20: and will place it on the altar with its libations, and the man will be duly cleansed.
verses.14:21: But if he is poor and his hand cannot find the things that were spoken for trespass, he will take a lamb for an offering, so that the priest may pray for him, and a tenth part of fine flour mixed with oil for a sacrifice, and a sextarius of oil,
verses.14:22: and two turtledoves or two young pigeons, one of which is to be for sin, and the other for a burnt offering;
verses.14:23: and he will offer them on the eighth day of his purification to the priest, at the doorway of the tabernacle of the testimony before the Lord.
verses.14:24: Receiving the lamb for trespass and the sextarius of oil, he will lift them up together;
verses.14:25: and when the lamb has been sacrificed, he will put some of its blood on the tip of the right ear of the one who is being cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand and the big toe of his right foot;
verses.14:26: and he will pour part of the oil into his left hand,
verses.14:27: and dipping a finger of his right hand in it, he will sprinkle seven times before the Lord;
verses.14:28: and he will touch the tip of the right ear of the one who is being cleansed, and the thumb of his right hand and the big toe of his right foot, in the place of the blood that was poured out for trespass;
verses.14:29: and the remaining part of the oil, which is in his left hand, he will pour on the head of the one who has been purified, so that he may appease the Lord for him;
verses.14:30: and he will offer a turtledove or a young pigeon,
verses.14:31: one for trespass, and the other for a burnt offering with its libations.
verses.14:32: This is the sacrifice of a leper who cannot have everything for his cleansing."
verses.14:33: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
verses.14:34: "When you have entered the land of Canaan, which I will give to you as a possession, if there is a plague of leprosy in a house,
verses.14:35: the one whose house it is will go, reporting to the priest, and will say, 'It seems to me that something like a plague of leprosy is in my house.'
verses.14:36: Then he will command that they carry everything out of the house before he enters it and sees whether it is leprous, so that all the things that are in the house may not become unclean. And afterward he will enter to examine the leprosy of the house;
verses.14:37: and when he sees on its walls something like little hollows disfigured with paleness or redness, and lower than the rest of the surface,
verses.14:38: he will go out of the doorway of the house and will immediately close it for seven days.
verses.14:39: And having returned on the seventh day, he will examine it; if he finds that the leprosy has grown,
verses.14:40: he will order that the stones in which the leprosy is be torn out, and that they be thrown outside the city into an unclean place;
verses.14:41: and that the house itself be scraped on the inside all around, and that the dust of the scraping be scattered outside the city into an unclean place,
verses.14:42: and that other stones be put back in place of those that were taken away, and that the house be plastered with other clay.
verses.14:43: But if, after the stones have been torn out, and the dust has been scraped off, and other earth has been plastered on,
verses.14:44: the priest, having entered, sees that the leprosy has returned and that the walls are speckled with spots, it is a persistent leprosy, and the house is unclean;
verses.14:45: and they will immediately tear it down and throw its stones and timbers, and all the dust, outside the town into an unclean place.
verses.14:46: Whoever enters the house when it is closed will be unclean until evening;
verses.14:47: and whoever sleeps in it and eats anything will wash his garments.
verses.14:48: But if the priest, entering, sees that the leprosy has not grown in the house after it has been plastered anew, he will purify it, since health has been restored;
verses.14:49: and for its purification he will take two sparrows, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop;
verses.14:50: and when one sparrow has been sacrificed in a clay vessel over living waters,
verses.14:51: he will take the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet, and the living sparrow, and he will dip them all in the blood of the sacrificed sparrow and in the living waters, and he will sprinkle the house seven times,
verses.14:52: and he will purify it both with the blood of the sparrow and with the living waters, and with the living sparrow, and the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet.
verses.14:53: And when he has released the sparrow to fly away freely into the field, he will pray for the house, and it will be lawfully cleansed.
verses.14:54: This is the law of every leprosy and affliction,
verses.14:55: of leprosy of garments and of houses,
verses.14:56: of a scar and of erupting pustules, of a shining spot, and when the colors have been changed into various appearances,
verses.14:57: so that it can be known at what time anything is clean or unclean."
verses.15:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
verses.15:2: "Speak to the sons of Israel, and say to them, 'A man who suffers a flow of seed will be unclean.
verses.15:3: And then he will be judged to be subject to this ailment, when moment by moment a foul fluid clings to his flesh and congeals.
verses.15:4: All bedding on which he sleeps will be unclean, and wherever he sits.
verses.15:5: If any person touches his bed, he will wash his garments, and having washed himself with water, he will be unclean until evening.
verses.15:6: If someone sits where that man had sat, he also will wash his garments, and having washed with water, he will be unclean until evening.
verses.15:7: The one who touches his flesh will wash his garments, and having washed himself with water, he will be unclean until evening.
verses.15:8: If a man of this kind casts saliva on one who is clean, he will wash his garments, and having washed with water, he will be unclean until evening.
verses.15:9: The saddle on which he sits will be unclean,
verses.15:10: and whatever has been beneath him who suffers a flow of seed will be defiled until evening. The one who carries any of these things will wash his garments, and having washed himself with water, he will be unclean until evening.
verses.15:11: Everyone whom such a man touches without first washing his hands will wash his garments, and having washed with water, he will be unclean until evening.
verses.15:12: An earthenware vessel that he touches will be shattered, but a wooden vessel will be washed with water.
verses.15:13: If the one who endures an affliction of this kind is healed, he will count seven days after his cleansing, and when his garments and his whole body have been washed in living waters, he will be clean.
verses.15:14: And on the eighth day he will take two turtledoves or two young pigeons, and come into the presence of the Lord to the entrance of the tabernacle of the testimony, and give them to the priest,
verses.15:15: who will prepare one for sin and the other as a burnt offering, and will pray for him before the Lord, so that he may be cleansed from the flow of his seed.
verses.15:16: A man from whom seed of intercourse goes out will wash his whole body with water, and he will be unclean until evening.
verses.15:17: He will wash with water the garment and leather that he has, and it will be unclean until evening.
verses.15:18: The woman with whom he has intercourse will wash herself with water, and she will be unclean until evening.
verses.15:19: A woman who suffers a flow of blood at the return of the month will be separated for seven days. Everyone who touches her will be unclean until evening,
verses.15:20: and whatever she sleeps or sits on during the days of her separation will be defiled.
verses.15:21: The one who touches her bed will wash his garments, and having washed himself with water, he will be unclean until evening.
verses.15:22: Whoever touches any article on which she sits will wash his garments, and having washed himself with water, he will be defiled until evening.
verses.15:24: If a man has intercourse with her at the time of menstrual blood, he will be unclean for seven days, and all bedding on which he sleeps will be defiled.
verses.15:25: A woman who suffers a flow of blood for many days not at the menstrual time, or who does not cease to flow after menstrual blood, will be unclean as long as she is subject to this affliction, as if she were in the menstrual time.
verses.15:26: All bedding on which she sleeps, and any article on which she sits, will be defiled.
verses.15:27: Whoever touches them will wash his garments, and having washed himself with water, he will be unclean until evening.
verses.15:28: If the blood stops and ceases to flow, she will count seven days of her purification,
verses.15:29: and on the eighth day she will offer for herself to the priest two turtledoves or two young pigeons, at the entrance of the tabernacle of the testimony,
verses.15:30: who will prepare one for sin and the other as a burnt offering, and will pray for her before the Lord, and for the flow of her uncleanness.'
verses.15:31: Therefore you will teach the sons of Israel to guard against uncleanness, and not die in their filth when they defile My tabernacle that is among them.
verses.15:32: This is the law of the one who suffers a flow of seed, and who is defiled by intercourse,
verses.15:33: and of her who is separated at menstrual times, or who flows with continual blood, and of the man who sleeps with her."
verses.16:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they were killed while offering strange fire,
verses.16:2: and commanded him, saying: "Speak to Aaron your brother, that he not enter at all times into the sanctuary that is inside the veil before the mercy seat by which the ark is covered, so that he may not die (for I will appear in a cloud over the oracle),
verses.16:3: unless he has done these things beforehand: he will offer a calf for sin, and a ram as a burnt offering.
verses.16:4: He will be clothed with a linen tunic, he will conceal his private parts with linen undergarments; he will be girded with a linen sash, he will place a linen turban on his head; for these are holy garments, in all of which he will dress himself when he has washed.
verses.16:5: And he will receive from the entire multitude of the sons of Israel two male goats for sin, and one ram as a burnt offering.
verses.16:6: And when he has offered the calf, and has prayed for himself and for his household,
verses.16:7: he will make the two male goats stand before the Lord at the entrance of the tabernacle of the testimony,
verses.16:8: and casting a lot over each of the two, one for the Lord, the other for the emissary goat.
verses.16:9: The one whose lot comes out for the Lord, he will offer it for sin;
verses.16:10: but the one whose lot is for the emissary goat, he will set it alive before the Lord, so that he may pour out prayers over it and send it out into the wilderness.
verses.16:11: When these things have been duly performed, he will offer the calf, and praying for himself and for his household, he will sacrifice it,
verses.16:12: and taking the censer, which he has filled from the live coals of the altar, and scooping up with his hand the compounded perfume for incense, he will enter beyond the veil into the holy place,
verses.16:13: so that, when the aromatics are placed on the fire, their cloud and vapor may cover the oracle that is above the testimony, and he may not die.
verses.16:14: He will also take some of the blood of the calf, and sprinkle with his finger seven times facing the mercy seat toward the east.
verses.16:15: And when he has slaughtered the male goat for the sin of the people, he will bring its blood inside the veil, just as was commanded concerning the blood of the calf, so that he may sprinkle it opposite the oracle,
verses.16:16: and expiate the sanctuary from the uncleannesses of the sons of Israel, and from their transgressions and all their sins. According to this rite he will do for the tabernacle of the testimony, which is pitched among them in the midst of the filth of their dwelling.
verses.16:17: Let no person be in the tabernacle when the high priest enters the sanctuary to pray for himself, and for his household, and for the entire assembly of Israel, until he comes out.
verses.16:18: And when he has gone out to the altar that is before the Lord, let him pray for himself, and having taken the blood of the calf and of the male goat, let him pour it on its horns all around;
verses.16:19: and sprinkling with his finger seven times, let him expiate and sanctify it from the uncleannesses of the sons of Israel.
verses.16:20: After he has cleansed the sanctuary, and the tabernacle, and the altar, then let him offer the living male goat;
verses.16:21: and having placed both hands on its head, let him confess all the iniquities of the sons of Israel, and all their offenses and sins; invoking these upon its head, he will send it out by a prepared man into the desert.
verses.16:22: And when the male goat has carried all their iniquities into a solitary land, and has been released in the desert,
verses.16:23: Aaron will return into the tabernacle of the testimony, and having taken off the garments with which he had previously been clothed when he entered the sanctuary, and having left them there,
verses.16:24: he will wash his flesh in a holy place, and will dress himself in his own garments. And after he has gone out and offered his own burnt offering and that of the people, he will pray both for himself and for the people,
verses.16:25: and he will burn on the altar the fat that was offered for sins.
verses.16:26: And the one who has released the emissary goat will wash his garments and his body with water, and thus he will enter into the camp.
verses.16:27: And they will carry outside the camp the calf and the male goat that had been sacrificed for sin, and whose blood was brought into the sanctuary so that the expiation might be completed, and they will burn up with fire both their hides and their flesh, and their dung;
verses.16:28: and whoever has burned them up will wash his garments and his flesh with water, and thus he will enter into the camp.
verses.16:29: And this will be an everlasting statute for you: in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, you will afflict your souls and do no work, whether a native or a foreigner who sojourns among you.
verses.16:30: On this day there will be expiation for you, and cleansing from all your sins; before the Lord you will be cleansed.
verses.16:31: For it is a Sabbath of rest, and you will afflict your souls by a perpetual observance.
verses.16:32: And the priest who has been anointed, and whose hands have been consecrated to perform the priesthood in place of his father, will make expiation; and he will be clothed with a linen robe and holy garments,
verses.16:33: and he will expiate the sanctuary, and the tabernacle of the testimony, and the altar, the priests also, and the entire people.
verses.16:34: And this will be an everlasting statute for you, that you pray for the sons of Israel, and for all their sins, once a year." Therefore he did just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.17:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.17:2: "Speak to Aaron and to his sons, and to all the sons of Israel, saying to them, 'This is the word that the Lord has commanded, saying,
verses.17:3: "Any man of the house of Israel, if he kills an ox or a sheep or a goat in the camp or outside the camp,
verses.17:4: and does not bring an offering to the Lord at the entrance of the tabernacle, he shall be guilty of blood; as if he had shed blood, so he shall perish from the midst of his people.
verses.17:5: Therefore the sons of Israel must bring to the priest their sacrifices that they kill in the field, so that they may be sanctified to the Lord before the entrance of the tabernacle of the testimony, and they may sacrifice them as peace offerings to the Lord.
verses.17:6: And the priest shall pour out the blood upon the altar of the Lord at the entrance of the tabernacle of the testimony, and he shall burn the fat for a sweet aroma to the Lord;
verses.17:7: and they shall never again offer their sacrifices to demons, with whom they have committed fornication. It shall be an everlasting statute for them and for their descendants."'
verses.17:8: And to them you shall say, 'Any man of the house of Israel and of the foreigners who sojourn among you, who offers a burnt offering or a sacrifice,
verses.17:9: and does not bring it to the entrance of the tabernacle of the testimony so that it may be offered to the Lord, he shall perish from his people.
verses.17:10: Any man of the house of Israel and of the foreigners who sojourn among them, if he eats blood, I will set My face firmly against his soul, and I will destroy it from his people,
verses.17:11: because the life of the flesh is in the blood; and I have given it to you so that upon the altar you may make expiation by it for your souls, and that the blood may be for the expiation of the soul.
verses.17:12: For this reason I have said to the sons of Israel, "No person among you shall eat blood, nor any of the foreigners who sojourn among you."
verses.17:13: Any man of the sons of Israel and of the foreigners who sojourn among you, if by hunting and bird-catching he catches a wild animal or a bird which it is lawful to eat, let him pour out its blood and cover it with earth.
verses.17:14: For the life of all flesh is in the blood; therefore I have said to the sons of Israel, "You shall not eat the blood of any flesh, because the life of the flesh is in the blood; and whoever eats it shall perish."
verses.17:15: Any person who eats what died of itself or what was seized by a wild beast, whether among the native-born or among the foreigners, shall wash his garments and himself with water, and he shall be contaminated until evening; and in this manner he shall become clean.
verses.17:16: But if he does not wash his garments and his body, he shall bear his iniquity.'"
verses.18:1: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.18:2: "Speak to the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them, 'I am the Lord your God.
verses.18:3: You shall not do according to the custom of the land of Egypt, in which you lived, and you shall not act according to the practice of the region of Canaan, to which I am about to bring you, nor shall you walk in their statutes.
verses.18:4: You shall do My judgments, and observe My precepts, and walk in them. I am the Lord your God.
verses.18:5: Keep My laws and judgments, by doing which a man shall live in them. I am the Lord.
verses.18:6: No man shall approach a close relative of his blood to expose her shame. I am the Lord.
verses.18:7: You shall not uncover the shame of your father and the shame of your mother; she is your mother; you shall not expose her shame.
verses.18:8: You shall not uncover the shame of your father's wife, for it is your father's shame.
verses.18:9: You shall not expose the shame of your sister, whether by your father or by your mother, who was born at home or outside.
verses.18:10: You shall not expose the shame of your son's daughter or of your granddaughter by your daughter, because it is your own shame.
verses.18:11: You shall not expose the shame of the daughter of your father's wife, whom she bore to your father, and who is your sister.
verses.18:12: You shall not uncover the shame of your father's sister, because she is your father's flesh.
verses.18:13: You shall not expose the shame of your mother's sister, since she is your mother's flesh.
verses.18:14: You shall not expose the shame of your paternal uncle, nor shall you approach his wife, who is joined to you by marriage.
verses.18:15: You shall not expose the shame of your daughter-in-law, because she is your son's wife, nor shall you uncover her disgrace.
verses.18:16: You shall not expose the shame of your brother's wife, because it is your brother's shame.
verses.18:17: You shall not expose the shame of your wife and of her daughter. You shall not take her son's daughter or her daughter's daughter to expose her disgrace, because they are her flesh, and such intercourse is incest.
verses.18:18: You shall not take your wife's sister as a rival concubine to her, nor shall you expose her shame while she is still living.
verses.18:19: You shall not approach a woman who is undergoing her menstrual flow, nor shall you expose her foulness.
verses.18:20: You shall not have intercourse with your neighbor's wife, nor shall you be defiled by the mingling of seed.
verses.18:21: You shall not give any of your seed to be consecrated to the idol Molech, nor shall you pollute the name of your God. I am the Lord.
verses.18:22: You shall not unite with a male in intercourse as with a woman, because it is an abomination.
verses.18:23: You shall not have intercourse with any animal, nor shall you be defiled with it. A woman shall not submit herself to a beast, nor unite with it, because it is a wicked deed.
verses.18:24: And do not pollute yourselves in any of these things by which all the nations have been contaminated, whom I will cast out before your sight,
verses.18:25: and by which the land has been polluted, whose wicked deeds I will punish, so that it may vomit out its inhabitants.
verses.18:26: Keep My statutes and judgments, and do not do any of all these abominations, whether the native-born or the resident alien who sojourns among you.
verses.18:27: For the residents of the land who were before you did all these detestable things, and they polluted it.
verses.18:28: Take care, therefore, that it does not similarly vomit you out too when you do like things, just as it vomited out the nation that was before you.
verses.18:29: Every person who does any of these abominations shall perish from the midst of his people.
verses.18:30: Keep My commandments. Do not do the things that those who were before you did, and do not pollute yourselves in them. I am the Lord your God.'"
verses.19:1: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.19:2: "Speak to the entire assembly of the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them, 'Be holy, because I am holy, the Lord your God.
verses.19:3: Each one shall fear his father and his mother. Keep My Sabbaths. I am the Lord your God.
verses.19:4: Do not turn to idols, nor make for yourselves molten gods. I am the Lord your God.
verses.19:5: If you offer a sacrifice of peace offerings to the Lord, so that it may be acceptable,
verses.19:6: on the day on which it is offered, you shall eat it, and on the next day; but whatever remains until the third day, you shall burn up with fire.
verses.19:7: If anyone eats from it after two days, he will be profane and guilty of impiety,
verses.19:8: and he will bear his iniquity, because he has defiled the holy thing of the Lord, and that soul will perish from its people.
verses.19:9: And when you harvest the crops of your land, you shall not shear the surface of the land all the way to the ground, nor shall you gather the remaining ears of grain,
verses.19:10: nor shall you collect the clusters and fallen grapes in your vineyard, but you shall leave them for the poor and the foreigners to pick. I am the Lord your God.
verses.19:11: You shall not commit theft. You shall not lie, nor shall anyone deceive his neighbor.
